messages:
maria: Heads-up — canary for release/2026-03-23 on embeddings route is spiking. p95 +120ms, error rate steady but latency breach. deploy-bot just flagged an autorevert recommendation. change window ends in ~40m. Do we let the bot do the revert or run a tight hotpatch?

raj: Can you paste the quick diffs from the canary? small config drift or model variant?

maria: It's a routing tweak — 'route: embeddings->v2.4.0' vs expected v2.4.0-quant. We changed kernel flags in last minute patch, might be kernel selection on GPU causing perf.

deploy-bot: AUTOREVERT_TRIP: canary=riff-embed-1, metric=p95_latency, threshold=+100ms, observed=+120ms. Action=revert suggested. See /revert plan id=rb-4964.

sam: if it's kernel selection miscompile, revert is safest. Hotpatch risk = more noise in same window.

erin: need to check release notes before any automated revert — customers on dedicated pools were notified about quant rollout. If we revert, update RN and notify those accounts.

maria: Agreed. I'm leaning revert. But prefer staged revert: only embeddings route first, keep rest of rollout going. That reduces blast radius.

raj: Does deploy system support partial route-level revert? yes — traffic-slice key exists. But that won't touch dedicated customers pinned to new variant. We'd need a dedicated rollback for hosted canary slice.

ops-bot: NOTE: partial-route reverts require ops authorization when change window <1h. Please ack.

sam: I can own ops auth. If we do partial revert, we should also pin a fallback model variant (v2.4.0-quant-stable) to avoid flip-flopping.

maria: @sam please run the staged revert for route embeddings->stable on canary slice. I'll prepare the release-notes diff and cust list. raj, want to run the revert command?

raj: On it. running: 
```
deploy rollback --target riff-embed-1 --route embeddings --from v2.4.0 --to v2.4.0-quant-stable --scope canary-slice-3
```

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollback started by raj. step1: traffic-slice shift 20% -> 0% for v2.4.0. step2: healthcheck monitoring. ETA approx 2m.

ops-bot: AUTH: approved by sam (ops). change window check passed.

maria: copying RN change: "Hotfix: revert embeddings route to quant-stable due to latency regression in canary (p95 +120ms)." Erin will you run customer notify?

erin: Will do — short note to dedicated customers + status page update. drafting now.

deploy-bot: step1 complete. traffic: 100% -> stable variant. healthchecks green after shift. observed p95 back to baseline within 90s.

raj: Confirming metrics: canary p95 now +8ms. No errors. Looks good.

maria: OK. keep monitoring for 30m. We will not unpin the dedicated customers until follow-up CI on kernel flags. Open follow-up ticket: ENG-4964 (investigate kernel selection).

sam: created ticket ENG-4964 and assigned to runtime team. linking to this thread.

erin: customer note sent. status page updated: "Mitigated — partial revert executed to address latency regression. Investigating root cause." :white_check_mark: 

maria: thanks all. marking this as manual-intervention (even though deploy-bot suggested revert). Good runbook execution.

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollback completed. record id rb-4964. timeline attached.

maria: closing thread once 30m stable window confirmed. if anything pops, re-open here. :pray:
